Section_Title: Year-over-Year Historical Baseline Engine Settings

Label: Current Season (being projected)
Note: Historical seasons are computed relative to this: Y-1, Y-2, Y-3.

Label: Historical Lookback Window (years)
Note: Documentation only in this template — the engine tab is built with exactly 3 prior-season columns. Extending beyond 3 years requires adding columns there.

Label: Decay Factor (weight ratio between consecutive prior years)
Note: Weight(Y-2) = Decay x Weight(Y-1); Weight(Y-3) = Decay^2 x Weight(Y-1). Lower = recent seasons dominate more.

Label: Carryover Weight (team's own history vs. league mean)
Note: 0 = full regression to the league average (ignore team history); 1 = pure team history, no regression to the mean.

Label: Last-Year Emphasis Weight (0-1, within the team-history component)
Note: 0 = rely purely on the 3-yr decay-weighted average; 1 = ignore the 3-yr average entirely and use only last year's (Y-1) number. Sits inside the team's own history, before that combined figure is regressed toward the league mean via Carryover Weight above.
